allocation.pooled_individual: alpha/5 divided by number of distinct fixed nonsingleton tree nodes

pooled_collection: Distinct nonsingleton nodes of the two preserved fixed trees, with full support once; frozen before new assignment observations. Estimated-order cells may use pooling only on exact membership in this fixed collection.

selection.historical: existing combined-family minimum-count selector with preserved secondary ties and cap predicates
selection.release: existing at-most-capacity minimax certificate selector with exact rational comparisons and preserved ties
selection.identity: one at K; never capacity fallback below K
selection.partial_bounds: safe lower-bound pruning only; complete relevant cells or certify lower/upper optimum agreement; unresolved is not infinity or infeasibility

diagnostics.oracle_margin: log(c / minimum population distortion among family partitions with at most the minimum oracle count)
diagnostics.oracle_count_certificate: minimum verified certificate over all family partitions with at most the oracle count; not certificate of one arbitrary oracle tie
diagnostics.capacity_decomposition: per-block log(U/d*) = log(U/Dselected)+log(Dselected/d*), preserve exact multiplicative identity before logs, never clip negative inflation on coverage misses
diagnostics.mass_slice: true fixed masses with original propensity intervals and original propensity confidence allocation unchanged; flag nonnested truth slices and retain misses
diagnostics.beta_split: equal positive shares over occupancy/propensity for known mass; occupancy/propensity/mass for unknown mass
diagnostics.numerical_expansion: actual maximum saved endpoint expansion per family; root fallbacks explicit; manuscript sufficient conditions marked inapplicable when violated
diagnostics.scope: actual values on explicitly evaluated partitions; no selected-partition maximum described as an all-partition maximum; analytical bound not used by selector

recovery.streams: SeedSequence([master,replication,component]); independent paths, nested count increments, shared state counts and nonexceptional-state action counts across paired laws; separate components for state counts, fair actions and exact4/13 actions
recovery.sampler: uniform-state multinomial sufficient-count increments; fair binomials; exceptional-state exact bounded integers0..12 with success<4; no millions-of-record materialization or rational mass rounding
recovery.qualification: iid ideal draw model; PCG64 reproducible implementation, no formal iid theorem for pseudorandom bits
recovery.method_information: provider receives counts/support/masses only in known-mass mode, never told homogeneous propensities; full fixed pooled collection allocation retained even when only full-support interval evaluated
recovery.reference_points: necessary lower bound1900 and exact-CP sufficient criterion at3million remain distinct from empirical first grid crossing of90%
recovery.theoretical_eta_scope: primary recovery b_n uses manuscript reference floor1/4 for both laws; truth-derived maximal floor reported separately

uncertainty: individual binary rates two-sided95% Clopper-Pearson; continuous summaries and paired within-independent-block differences use pointwise mean +/-1.96SE; explicit denominators/infinity/unresolved frequencies; equal weight for each of original48conditions
interpretation: retrospective assignment-only comparison; pooled certification uses a common error allocation and yields a valid upper bound rather than the exact intersection supremum; the empirical gaps do not establish minimax lower bounds
